title.en: An Act Appropriating Funds for the Construction, Repair, and Maintenance of Rural Roads and Bridges on the So-Called "Friar Estate.

text.en:
The Director of Lands is hereby authorized to for expend seventy-five thousand pesos of the friar
lands funds, reimbursable out of the funds of the Insular Treasury, for the construction, maintenance, and
repair of roads, trails, and bridges on the friar estates acquired by the Government and at present under the
administration of the Bureau of Lands.

The funds appropriated by this Act shall be distributed by the Secretary of Agriculture and
Natural Resources among the municipalities in which said estates are located, subject to the approval of the
presiding officers of both Houses of the Legislature.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, February 19, 1921.
